meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor submitting a bid
gaps: The exact vendor identity and date/time values recorded for the bid cannot be asserted dynamically.
That all activity lines are in chronological time order cannot be reliably asserted without known entry text and direction.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact vendor identity and date/time values recorded for the bid cannot be asserted dynamically.; That all activity lines are in chronological time order cannot be reliably asserted without known entry text and direction.

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event creation flow.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Use an RFQ stage because the case concerns a vendor submitting a bid.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the vendor has a line on which to bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the buyer reached the published event page.
Have a QA vendor submit a bid through the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor submission was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer from Settings.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Confirm earlier event activity remains present.
Confirm the activity history contains a vendor submission entry.
Check that the activity entry exposes the QA vendor identity or company prefix.
